parsed.compliance_time_text: At whichever of the following compliance times occurs later: at the next annual inspection after March 19, 2013; within the next 100 hours time-in-service after March 19, 2013; or within the next 12 calendar months after March 19, 2013, inspect the fuel return line assembly for damage. Replace if damaged, or reinstall if not damaged, before further flight, then install the forward and aft support clamps and brackets and inspect clearances before further flight.

unsafe_condition_summary:
This AD was prompted by reports of chafing of a new configuration of the fuel return line
assembly, which was caused by the fuel return line assembly rubbing against the right steering tube
assembly during rudder pedal actuation.
